authored_assumptions: This is an original detailed interpretation of the existing lamp, not a scanned or recovered industrial product.
The eight named joints and their rest coordinates are preserved; all hidden hardware, cord routing and shade interior are authored.
The open shade includes separate outer and interior wall surfaces, aperture trim, rear cap and bulb; the warm diffuser is geometry, not an emitted simulated light.
Arms, hinge caps, springs and cord sections use explicit rigid or blended skin weights; no mechanical spring, cable or electrical simulation is claimed.
The pad retains a fixed circular guide; the stylus traces gestures without dynamically creating ink.
Opaque PBR metal/roughness and embedded procedural brushed textures target the browser, not Weft's restricted diffuse-only profile.
The four skeletal actions are authored local animations and do not duplicate a simulator or change Weft actions or rewards.

uv_repair.method: Per-loop geometric-plane UV projection for collapsed UVs or cancelling UV fans; other UV seams unchanged. Tangents are computed by Blender MikkTSpace, not replaced.

generation.local_compute: CPU, up to 4 threads; resource usage in job.json

origin: Agent-authored procedural geometry and skeletal keyframes; not neural reconstruction or an analytic fixture

attachments.placement: Static paper pad in front-right of the lamp base.
A vertically sliding stylus held at radius0.17m around the work-pad guide, with its tip at0.12m when lowered.

states.meaning: A small inquisitive look-around: base swivel and two opposing shade tilts.
Lowers the visible stylus onto its fixed circular guide and traces two back-and-forth arcs while the shade aims at the pad. No new marks are generated.
Stretches into a proud upright pose and gives two delighted shade nods before folding back.
Leans toward the work pad and makes a broad slow inspection sweep, unlike the short repetitive tracing state.

style: Premium miniature task lamp: burgundy enamel, brushed brass, layered working hinges and a hollow bell shade
subject: A burgundy articulated desk-lamp robot with a brass shade, warm bulb, paired hinge bars and a cream work pad. A small base-mounted rotary stylus traces a fixed guide on the pad.
